items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I have faith in one of the fellows that helped me along the way was a fellow from MCA and I could never forget him, (Junior Wist (?)).

ctx.x: Yeah, it's been rough but I mean that's really, I mean various things have come up and ...

... what has happened with me, I made a little decision back in the '40s so if I got a terrific one guy's note, with all due respect, see if I can play two more, three more and ... supposed to get together, let's see what happens. And, pardon me, I think I'm very happy about it because if you're prepared to give yourself expression and I have faith in one of the fellows that helped me along the way was a fellow from MCA and I could never forget him, (Junior Wist (?)). I was over here at Rutgers and ... had some…

I said, You do? Where from? I'd gone over and had this thing over here ... where/you go to get that punch and all that kind of business so I'm going to have some punch, you know. ... make a long story short, he was from a band in New York and we got to talking and he gave me just as much inspiration; he said I know you drew worked for a long time and get in there and we do some people out there, you know, a big audience, around 5,000 people we had in there who drove out to listen to what we were doing. ... that's…
